rationale: After one focused bounded-context remediation, all five Full Brain scenarios generated coherent candidate architecture packages and passed the corrected frozen rubric gates.
Agency Banking passed, and no scenario retained a critical security or resilience omission.
AIW Full Brain scored 96.20 versus 95.18 for generic GPT-5.6 Sol and 79.75 for deterministic-only.
The numerical advantage over the generic model is small, but AIW materially strengthens governed traceability, replayability, lifecycle integration, candidate authority and SDD delivery.
The UI journey completed for Agency Banking and Core Banking Modernisation, while also exposing an important gap: no actionable design-stage candidate was generated in the tested stage panels.
